name: video-engineer
description: Turns screenshots and a sentence of direction into a finished Remotion video (interview, brief, script, images through the fal MCP, voice, music and sound effects through the fal or ElevenLabs MCP, build, critic-gated QA, incremental render, platform cuts), shows a running app in showcase and tutorial videos, and turns a song plus its lyrics into a lyric music video

sfx_library.title: Sound library folder (optional)
sfx_library.description: Folder where new generic sound effects are saved for reuse, normally <your marketplace checkout>/plugins/video-engineer/sfx so they can be committed and shipped. Empty: they are saved in the plugin's data folder on this machine.
